editorial:
Imagine the two scariest beings in existence crashing a fancy destination wedding. You get to see the Grim Reaper and the Devil trying to ruin a party, only to accidentally fall head over heels for each other. The vibe is light, weird, and totally unexpected. It takes the idea of a rom-com and flips it on its head by making the leads supernatural entities who usually hate everyone. You will love how they clash at first before realizing they are the only two people in the room who truly get each other.

The acting is the real winner here, as the chemistry between the leads makes the fantasy elements feel grounded and funny. While the plot moves a bit slow in the middle, the jokes and the fancy wedding setting keep you interested. If you want a movie that is just plain fun, you should definitely check this one out. It looks gorgeous, so you should try streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to see all the colors. If you are a movie collector, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a great move for a rainy day.
endingExplained: At the end, the Reaper and the Devil decide that their love is more important than their jobs. They stop trying to cause chaos at the wedding and choose to stay together as a couple. The twist is that by choosing love over hate, they accidentally bring a sense of peace to the humans around them. They fly off together, leaving the wedding guests confused but happy, proving that even the darkest souls can find a match.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves weird romances and dark humor.
